Definition: from G2756 and G1391; vainly glorifying, i.e. self-conceited:--desirous of vain-glory.
BiblicalUsage: Kenodoxos means desirous of vainglory, self-conceited. Galatians 5:26 says let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe wanting to be admired is the root of provoking and envying, and Paul cuts it off at the root.
